candidate_profiles.clipping: NONE_IN_PREPROCESSOR; model quantization policy is a later T-B4 concern
candidate_profiles.tradeoff: Preserves physical Celsius information and is the clean canonical baseline; existing legacy model calibration may not accept it without a separately declared model/input contract.

candidate_profiles.clipping: NONE_BY_DEFAULT; any later clipping must be a preregistered ablation
candidate_profiles.tradeoff: Controls global scale using TRAIN statistics while preserving spatial thermal structure; statistics must be serialized and applied unchanged to VALIDATION and REAL_EVAL_DEVELOPMENT.

candidate_profiles.formula: y = (x - min_frame) / (max_frame - min_frame) when range > 0; otherwise clip(x,0,1)
candidate_profiles.input_source: T-A6 canonical float32 Celsius frame or an explicitly identified legacy frame
candidate_profiles.tradeoff: Enables a fair legacy compatibility comparison but discards absolute temperature and cannot be presented as the canonical physical representation.
